subject: POC throughput runway: request for promotional credit infusion
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Kaur <samir.kaur@bluehorizon.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: POC throughput runway: request for promotional credit infusion

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for agreeing to the end-to-end throughput and latency validation for the conversational endpoint. To make the overnight soak and the scheduled stress window useful we recommend a short runway of promotional credits from our side so your test team can run a continuous 36–48 hour sweep without interruption.

High level ask: can we provision ~150k token-equivalent trial credit (ephemeral) scoped to your BH test project for a 48-hour window beginning 2027-03-08 20:00 PT? Goal is to validate 6k qps aggregate across 4 client streams with target p95 < 120ms for typical 256-token responses.

I've attached a compact POC_Capacity_Plan.xlsx (timeline + expected QPS slots) and put the test harness link in the mailbox. If you're good with timing we can finalize the window and I'll loop Eng for capacity confirmation and Lauren for promotional approval.

Next steps:
- Confirm the start time and expected max concurrent streams
- Confirm whether results should be captured and shared as CSV (we can push post-test samples)
- If yes, we’ll finalize credit amount and scope (project-level)

Thanks,
Rafael
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: POC_Capacity_Plan.xlsx (spreadsheet, 34KB)
From: Samir Kaur <samir.kaur@bluehorizon.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC throughput runway: request for promotional credit infusion

Hi Rafael —

Thanks, this looks promising. Quick clarifications:
1) 150k tokens — does that map to an expected number of requests for our payloads? We run ~200 tokens in the prompt + 256 response average.
2) We need the test to capture p50/p95/p99 and throughput per shard. CSV output is fine.
3) Can we start 2027-03-09 02:00 UTC (that maps to evening PT) instead of the 8th? Our infra team prefers a weekday window for on-call coverage.

If you can confirm the mapping and whether Redwood can restrict the credits to a project id (not our billing), we can lock the date.

—Samir
Head of Platform, Blue Horizon AI
ops+perf@bluehorizon.ai

Subject: Re: POC throughput runway: request for promotional credit infusion

Samir —

Good questions. Short answers:
- 150k tokens is a conservative cap. Based on your numbers (~200 prompt + ~256 response) it's roughly ~200–250k requests depending on exact tokenization and streaming behavior; we can scope by request count instead if you prefer.
- We will emit p50/p95/p99 latency and per-shard qps; we can provide the raw CSV (see sample name throughput-results-sample.csv).
- 2027-03-09 02:00 UTC works for us — thanks for the heads up.
- Yes, we can scope the promo credits to a project id inside your trial account so they are isolated from your long-term billing and automatically expire after the window.

Marcus, can you confirm capacity for the requested throughput (6k aggregate qps across four streams) during that window? If there's any capacity constraint we should flag now so Blue Horizon can adjust the harness.

Samir — once Marcus signs off I’ll ask Lauren for the formal promotional credit authorization and send the project-scoped grant.

Thanks,
Rafael

Subject: Re: POC throughput runway: request for promotional credit infusion

Rafael / Samir —

Capacity check: engineering looked at profile and the requested 6k aggregate qps for the 48h window is feasible on Dedicated test pool with current slot availability. Two notes:
1) We recommend pinning to the LlamaX-16q model variant (quantized) and enabling KV cache sharing to reduce per-token GPU cost during the long sweep.
2) Please limit maximum concurrent per-client streams to 2 to avoid hotspotting single-worker attachments; we’ll provide routing hints.

I’ll prepare a short runbook for your test lead with the expected endpoints, streaming flags, and a CSV template for metrics.

Marcus
Senior Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Team —

Authorization: Approved. I authorize a one-time promotional credit grant of 150,000 token-equivalent credits scoped to Blue Horizon AI project BH-PROJ-77 for the 48-hour window starting 2027-03-09 02:00 UTC and expiring 2027-03-11 02:00 UTC. Conditions:
- Any consumption beyond the grant will be invoiced at the trial rate and require explicit opt-in by the customer before billing begins.
- The credits are non-transferable and will be auto-revoked at the end of the window.
- Engineering to confirm runbook is distributed to Blue Horizon prior to start.

I’ve attached a short promo-credit-grant.pdf (internal approval memo) for records. Rafael, please record the approval in HubSpot (deal BH-4491) and notify Finance if the customer later requests an extension.

Lauren Bishop
